description:
Activate Skullclamp's equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to Kobolds of Kher Keep.
Kobolds of Kher Keep dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness, triggering Enduring Renewal and Skullclamp.
Resolve the Enduring Renewal trigger, returning Kobolds of Kher Keep from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Skullclamp trigger, causing you to draw two cards.
Cast Kobolds of Kher Keep by paying {0}.
Repeat.
